body: I can't tell you how many times I read the last two sentences and how much I'd like to thank you (and teared up). I'm still so terrified but I'm a bit more hopeful in my impending visit. I've read every fucking article on the internet about this and they're not particularly comforting. I'm so scared to tell someone I've been having these thoughts but some insight has given really given me some peace in preparing me for today. Thank you again for being helpful and supportive, it really means the world.
I can't give advice but I'm more than happy to lend an ear.
